title: fix(app-shell): the Attachments tab offers the uploader Delete and Rename on their own upload
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9XS45uS4YmpkyKDUwCT41Tq)_

Fixes #36488

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 普通成员在记录的「附件」页签上，对自己上传的文件现在能看到并使用「删除」和「重命名」；以前两项都不显示。
- 补上附件删除改名工作的控制台一半：服务端早已允许上传者删改自己的附件，界面却一直不给入口。
- 别人上传的文件对普通成员仍然两项都不显示；若判断出错，最坏是多出一个会被服务端拒绝并提示原因的菜单项，可直接撤回本改动。
- 无

## What changes

The Attachments panel judges each row the way the storage service's two attachment doors do, instead of by the `sys_attachment` grant alone:

| Row | Delete | Rename |
| --- | --- | --- |
| The caller's own upload (`uploaded_by` names the signed-in user) | always, through the removal door `DELETE /api/v1/attachments/:id` | always, through the rename door `PATCH /api/v1/attachments/:id` |
| Another user's upload | with the `delete` grant, through the data door (unchanged) | with the edit grant (the delete grant no longer gates it) |

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordAttachmentsPanel.tsx`: `isOwnUpload` / `canDeleteRow` / `canRename` per row; `handleDelete` sends the caller's own row to the removal door and every other row to `dataSource.delete` as before; the removal and rename calls share one `callAttachmentDoor`. The panel's long comment that said "being the uploader does not change that" described the data door only and now says which door each row uses.
- `ui/packages/core/src/utils/affordanceGrants.ts`: comments only, on the `attachmentDelete` / `attachmentRename` rows (asked only for rows the caller did not upload). No map entry changes.
- `content/docs/permissions/attachments-access.mdx`: the one sentence describing what the console's Attachments tab offers, which this change made false.
- `.changeset/36488-uploader-own-attachment-delete-rename.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch.

**Premise measured before writing.** Both server doors admit the uploader with no grant beyond read: `registerOwnRowDeleteRoute` (removal: read as caller, `uploaded_by` equals caller, system delete) and `renameAttachment` (uploader limb writes under a system context). `attachment-removal-routes.integration.test.ts` on the base (`87c7bbaf`) passed 16/16 under the lock, and the dogfood suite `member-attachment-baseline.dogfood.test.ts` pins the same on the real plugin-security stack ("the uploader removes their own attachment through the door: 200", with the data door still refusing them 403). The panel's old comment was correct about the data door, which is the door the panel called.

## Tests

Changed test file: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/RecordAttachmentsPanel.affordanceGrant-12047.test.tsx` (the panel's real-`MePermissionsProvider` harness).

- New describe "the uploader deletes and renames their own upload with no grant beyond the member baseline (objectstack#36488)": a plain member (read and create) sees Download, Rename, Delete on their own row and only Download on another member's (string and expanded `uploaded_by`); their delete goes to `DELETE /api/v1/attachments/a2` and never to `dataSource.delete`; their rename PATCHes the rename door; a refused removal keeps the row and shows the refusal; a delete-grant holder's delete of another member's row still goes through the data door and sends no fetch.
- Updated: the read-only and create-grant cases now assert on another user's row only (the own row moved to the new describe); the edit-without-delete Rename case now expects Rename on every row and Delete only on the own row.

Unchanged and still green: `RecordAttachmentsPanel.test.tsx`, `RecordAttachmentsPanel.deleteConfirm-12248.test.tsx`, `RecordAttachmentsPanel.supersededRecord-10684.test.tsx`, `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/affordanceGrantMap-12082.test.tsx`.

<details><summary>Readings (head 7183b1b2, after merging origin/main)</summary>

- Panel suites, under the verify lock: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run` over the four `RecordAttachmentsPanel*` files, `RecordDetailView.recordOpenWaves-13010.test.tsx` and `plugin-form/src/affordanceGrantMap-12082.test.tsx`: `Test Files 6 passed (6)`, `Tests 145 passed (145)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/core run type-check`: exit 0 (app-shell's `tsconfig.test.json` compiles the test files).
- Premise, on base 87c7bbaf: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-storage exec vitest run src/attachment-removal-routes.integration.test.ts`: `Tests 16 passed (16)`.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (one-off, through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored to the HEAD blob)</summary>

- `canDeleteRow` reduced to the grant alone (`=> canDelete`): mutation landed (anchor 1 to 0, blob e548182f to 6d07c5a2); `Tests 5 failed, 11 passed (16)`: the four new own-row cases that reach Delete, plus the edit-without-delete case. Restored: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- The own-row branch of `handleDelete` disabled (`if (false)`): mutation landed (blob e548182f to 0c344040); `Tests 2 failed, 14 passed (16)`: "deleting their own upload goes through the removal door…" and "a removal the door refuses keeps the row…". Restored: blob equals HEAD.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Done when, item by item: (1) plain member, own upload: Delete and Rename offered and both succeed (new describe, cases 1, 3, 4; server side pinned by the integration and dogfood suites above); (2) another member's upload: neither offered (case 1 and 2); (3) pinned for both cases in the panel's tests.
- The delete grant no longer gates Rename on another user's row. The rename door writes such a rename as the caller through the engine, which asks the edit grant and the update gate, never the delete grant; the old gate was the panel's own. A holder of the edit grant but not delete now sees Rename on others' rows; the server's update gate still refuses a non-editor of the record with `RECORD_NOT_ACCESSIBLE`, which the panel already names.
- The panel still cannot see the parent-editor half of the server rule, so a delete-grant holder keeps Delete on every row and the server's refusal is shown, as before.
- Docs page edited is under `content/docs/permissions/`, not `content/docs/frontend/`: no frontend page describes this panel's row menu; the permissions page carried the only sentence this change made false.

## Verification

Read first: `RecordAttachmentsPanel.tsx` (`handleDelete`'s own-row branch and `canDeleteRow` / `canRename`), then the new describe in the test file.

Two-minute check: sign in as a plain member on the showcase app, open a record of an object with `enable.files`, upload a file on the Attachments tab, open its ⋮ menu: Download, Rename, Delete attachment. Another member's file shows Download only.
